Package com.privatechain.core.builder

Class BlockchainConfig.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.core.builder.BlockchainConfig.Builder
Enclosing class:
BlockchainConfig
public static final class BlockchainConfig.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for BlockchainConfig.

All fields have production-ready defaults so that builder().build() produces a working in-memory chain (FR-CFG-02).

    • consensusEngine

      public BlockchainConfig.Builder consensusEngine(ConsensusEngine engine)
      Sets the consensus engine.

      If not set, defaults to a no-op engine (accepts all blocks). Production chains must supply a real engine.

      Parameters:
      engine - the engine to use (non-null)
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if engine is null

    • build

      public BlockchainNode build()
      Builds the configuration and returns a ready-to-start BlockchainNode.

      Lazy defaults are resolved here so that blockchain-core never hard-imports classes from blockchain-consensus or blockchain-storage.

      Returns:
      a configured, not-yet-started BlockchainNode

    • buildConfig

      public BlockchainConfig buildConfig()
      Builds and returns the raw BlockchainConfig without wrapping it in a node.

      Useful for testing or DI containers that construct the node separately.

      Returns:
      a fully configured, immutable BlockchainConfig
